lines.text: Meta says AI agents now do over sixty percent of a big engineering chore.
Meta runs many models that decide which ads to show. Each one is built a little differently.
lines.title: The problem

lines.text: Before, expert engineers tuned each model by hand. That took time and lots of computing.
lines.title: Adapting a technique

lines.text: Agents find good techniques, adapt them, run the training, and fix failures.
lines.title: What agents do

lines.text: Meta estimates three times the output and a median four times less training compute.
lines.title: Early results

lines.text: Engineers now approve plans and set priorities, while agents do the legwork.
lines.title: Takeaway
